items.question: What identities and supreme lordship are ascribed to Śambhu in this enumeration?
premises: Dambha and Lobha are named within the sequence of epithets.
Śambhu is explicitly identified by name.
Śambhu is characterized as the great lord of all beings.
items.inference: Śambhu is presented as encompassing these named aspects and holding sovereignty over all beings.
uncertainties: Whether dambha and lobha function as direct epithets of Śambhu or as distinct named entities in the list is context-dependent.
items.plain_english: Arrogance, greed, and indeed Śambhu, the great lord of all beings.
